newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar firms as August, October dominate.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar firms as August, October dominate.

text.p: LIFFE sugar moved higher, attention focussed on soon-to-expire front month August and October.
Switches from August into October made up a hefty chunk of volume, traders said. By 1040 GMT it was $1.10 higher at $320.30. August volume was 686 of the total 1,023 lots done.
Volume was also boosted by AA trades, traders said.
"People are just squaring off their August positions. That's all that's happening today," one trader said.
